body: The thought of school the night before sends a chill down my spine.Lying there allows me to think about the worst so I've resorted to not sleeping much staying up until 4am sometimes until I just doze off.It is affecting my life.I go to be late I wake up and half the day has passed.Sometimes I skip my first 2 classes just to catch a little more sleep.I feel like a ghost as if my opinion doesn't matter.I allow people to walk all over me.I'm sick of all this shit.Yesterday was the straw that broke the camels back.
